- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (high sentiment > 0.7) — reduce forecast by 5–10% for sentiment > 0.75.
- Underestimate prices after sharp spikes (forecast > true by >10%) — apply downward correction if sentiment drops below 0.6.
- Lagged overreaction: if forecast peaks 2–3 days after sentiment peak, reduce by 5–10% to avoid overcorrection.
- Mean reversion bias: if forecast is >15% above recent 7-day average, adjust downward by 5–8% if sentiment is neutral or declining.
- Horizon-specific: for 30-day forecasts, reduce forecast by 3–5% if sentiment is below 0.5 over last 5 days — avoid overconfidence in low sentiment.
- Avoid “overshoot after spike” — if forecast rises sharply after a 3+ day uptrend, cap at +5% above prior peak unless sentiment > 0.85.
